Riley (Partnerships): Heads up — Beacon Health went live on MedMarket this morning and signed a 1yr dedicated commitment. Listing url: https://medmarket.io/beacon-health :tada:
Tess (AE): Contract and PO processed. Upsell included: 24/7 support add-on and dedicated throughput plan. Sending invoice copy to finance.
Omar (Customer Success): Onboarding started. Verified VPC peering and private deployment checklist. Small follow-up: audit logs need to be forwarded to their Splunk instance (sending config snippet).
legal-bot: Marketplace addendum accepted by Beacon Health. No outstanding legal issues.
Priya (Marketing): Love it! Can we get a short customer quote for the spotlight? Also need a screenshot of the med-dash view.
Tess (AE): Reached out — got this quote from their CTO: "Redwood's private deployment let us meet compliance without slowing innovation." Sharing in doc now.
Omar (Customer Success): Uploaded demo screenshot and onboarding runbook: https://redwood-internal/playbooks/beacon-onboard.md. Note for CS: enable audit-forwarding in env var AUDIT_FORWARD=true.
Riley (Partnerships): Thanks team. Scheduling co-marketing call next week. I'll add Asana task and tag @Priya @Omar @Tess. Closing thread.
